title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Better Targeting Student Payments) Bill 2019
short_title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Better Targeting Student Payments) Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would restrict relocation scholarships to students whose family home is in Australia and who study in Australia.
Students whose family home is outside Australia or who relocate overseas for part of their course would no longer qualify.
The bill also aligns the Pensioner Education Supplement and Education Entry Payment with the 2017-18 Budget measure.
changes: Removes relocation scholarship eligibility for students whose parental family home is outside Australia.
Removes relocation scholarship eligibility for students who relocate outside Australia to study.
Aligns the Pensioner Education Supplement and Education Entry Payment.
summary.affected: Youth allowance students and recipients of the Pensioner Education Supplement and Education Entry Payment.
